subject.title: feat(macos): visible-markdown copy, full-message reader, and independent reasoning/tool toggles

question: Should the newly shared full-message reader ship as a macOS-only capability until iOS implements `chat.message.get`, or should this PR implement the iOS transport path before the shared action is enabled?
rationale: The title scopes the work to macOS, but the shared model/view changes make truncated rows actionable on hosts whose transport currently returns nil; maintainers need to choose the intended cross-platform product boundary.

options.title: Gate by transport capability
options.body: Add an explicit false-by-default capability and expose the action only from macOS until an iOS implementation is separately ready.

options.title: Implement iOS parity now
options.body: Add the iOS `chat.message.get` transport implementation and prove the same reader flow on both native hosts.

recommendation.title: Gate by transport capability
recommendation.body: Add an explicit false-by-default capability and expose the action only from macOS until an iOS implementation is separately ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR owns the shared and macOS implementation choices, while a maintainer must confirm the intended iOS scope.
